name: Taifoon — buy by demand (a need in words, matched, graded, settled on chain)

nodes.name: Start
nodes.notes: in: — → out: — · start a run (swap for a Schedule or Webhook trigger)

assignments.name: need
assignments.value: the sha256 digest of the text "hello from an n8n workflow"

nodes.name: Need
nodes.notes: in: — → out: hire.json · the need in words (the layer maps words to a class by fixed rules, never a model) and the buyer label the explorer shows

nodes.name: Post demand
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: hire.json · POST /v1/demands on the credential: 201 { demand { id dm_…, state open } }; a 4xx names the classes or what is missing (next_step)

nodes.name: Wait 20 s
nodes.notes: in: hire.json | job.json → out: hire.json · the auto-match loop on box 116 runs every 2 minutes; poll gently

nodes.name: Get demand
nodes.notes: in: hire.json → out: job.json · GET /v1/demands/{id}: open → claimed → matched → hired → graded → settling → settled, or unmatched / failed with why

nodes.name: Ended?
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · stop polling once the state ends (['settled', 'unmatched', 'failed', 'cancelled']) or after 45 polls

nodes.name: Explorer
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · GET /v1/explorer/jobs/{demand}: buyer, doer, payee (seller of record), the code grade, money and every devnet transaction with its link

nodes.name: Verify on chain
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · POST /v1/attest/hire: the settle transaction and the payee are re-derived from chain (REAL | FABRICATED | UNVERIFIED) before anyone acts on the result

nodes.name: Receipt
nodes.notes: in: job.json → out: job.json · the whole job in one item: demand, seller, grade, settle tx and its link, the attestation verdict

meta.description: Post what you need in words; the layer picks the seller, hires it, grades the reply by code and settles on the devnet 36927. Poll the demand, read the explorer row and check the settle transaction against the chain before you use the result.
